exposure: early primary surgical closure (<14th postnatal day)
late primary surgical closure (>=14th postnatal day)
secondary surgical closure after ibuprofen failure
cohort: Very-low-birth-weight preterm infants born between 2014 and 2021 who received active treatment for haemodynamically significant patent ductus arteriosus (hsPDA).
finding: Surgical patent ductus arteriosus closure is not inferior to pharmacologic treatment; however, early surgical closure is associated with lower rates of severe BPD compared to late closure, and secondary surgical closure carries the highest risk of PLCS/AKI, especially in extremely premature infants.
gest_age: Preterm, with a specific focus on extremely premature infants (<28 weeks)
